gbn2.reason: OpenMM's generic GBn2 expression does not reproduce Amber's signed near-pair descreening branch for sulfur's negative screening radius; the provider must fail closed instead of reporting approximate parity.

lcpo_expectation.reason: Amber gbsa=1 applies carbon surface-area parameters to chlorine, while OpenMM LCPO uses a chlorine-specific term; only polar GB is a parity target.
Amber gbsa=1 applies carbon surface-area parameters to bromine, while OpenMM LCPO fails closed because no bromine parameters are available; only polar GB is a parity target.
Amber gbsa=1 applies carbon surface-area parameters to iodine, while OpenMM LCPO fails closed because no iodine parameters are available; only polar GB is a parity target.

Amber gbsa=1 supplies an LCPO surface term for tetravalent sulfone sulfur, while OpenMM LCPO fails closed because it has no parameters for sulfur with four heavy-atom bonds; only polar GB is a parity target.
